messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — Hosted API (us-east-1) regression: p95 latency 5.6s (+120%), queue length 32k, 2.1% 5xx. Dashboard: https://redwood.monitoring/alerts/INC-XXXX :rotating_light:
Aisha: oncall here, looking now. can someone confirm if autoscaler is moving?
Tom: checking autoscaler logs — looks like scale requests are being rejected. last message: 
```
autoscaler ERROR: scale_request rejected - reached max_replicas (20)
reason: quota_or_limit (scale_bound)
last_cloud_err: Google API 403 Quota exceeded for GPUs in project redwood-prod-us-east1
```
Jin: oh — so autoscaler tried to go above 20 but blocked by quota. that would explain queue growth if we can't add workers. p95 spike lines up with the moment the scale attempt hit quota.
Lena: paging ops-cc to confirm if we have spare dedicated capacity we can borrow. @ops-bot queue the incident in #incidents with priority-high.
ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-3345 and pushed notification to #incidents. Handoff tag: aisha.
Aisha: quick impact summary: hosted API is returning timeouts for some requests and p95/p99 token latencies >5s / >12s respectively for ~15 minutes. Affected customers: high-traffic partner integration (tenant: partner-alpha), some bursty public traffic. Estimated 18k active inflight requests waiting on GPU.
Sam (Support): queue is causing timeouts for partner-alpha's background jobs. they're seeing retries and some errors. I've flagged their account to CSM and asked for patience.
Tom: digging into router logs — fallback routing policy didn't kick because model_variant fallback table had 0 capacity for redwood-small-v1 in us-east. the routing policy requires at least 2 replicas to mark variant healthy.
Jin: two-pronged mitigation idea: 1) temporarily rate-limit partner-alpha to reduce incoming rate. 2) carve out /hotstart a smaller model variant (redwood-small-xq) and route a portion of traffic there while we add capacity.
Aisha: agree. rate-limiting first. can someone apply a tenant rate-limit at the edge? Tom?
Tom: applying rate-limit rule now: 
```
# apply temporary tenant limit
rbctl tenant set-rate partner-alpha --rps 180 --window 60
```
Tom: rule applied. monitor shows ~60% drop in new enqueues within 30s.
Lena: can we borrow GPUs from Dedicated? I see a free pool in eu-west but not us-east. ops request to infra to request quota bump from cloud.
ops-bot: Submitted support request to cloud provider for temporary GPU quota bump — ticket CLOUD-98765.
Jin: while quota request is pending, I'll try to spin up redwood-small-xq in us-east from pre-warmed image. if we can get 4 replicas, we can handle the 30% of requests routed there.
Tom: redwood-small-xq image exists in registry, attempting deploy: 
```
deployctl deploy --cluster us-east-1 --model redwood-small-xq --replicas 4 --route hosted-prod-fallback
```
Tom: deploy succeeded but xq nodes are slow to warm (kv-cache cold). routing config requires manual weight change.
Aisha: ok set routing to split 35% -> small-xq, 65% -> normal. run config:
```
routingctl set-weight hosted-prod hosted-prod-fallback=0.35
```
ops-bot: routing change applied.
Tom: after routing change p95 dropped to 2.1s in 90s, queue drained from 32k to 9k in ~6 minutes. p99 still elevated but trending down.
Jin: good. continuing to watch kv-cache hit rates. we should also non-disruptively purge aged queued requests >120s that are likely fractional retries.
Aisha: agree. Tom, can you kick a quick purge of requests older than 120s? Make it staged to avoid reordering.
Tom: running: 
```
rcctl queue purge --cluster us-east-1 --older-than 120s --batch 5000
```
Tom: purge in progress — removed ~4.8k stale requests across worker-shards. queue now 4.2k.
Lena: cloud quota ticket got update — provider says they can grant +6 GPUs in us-east but need 30m. good to know if we want to wait.
Aisha: given fallback is handling a lot, let's accept +6 GPUs and scale up manually to stabilize. manual scale: set replicas from 20 -> 26 temporarily. Tom, coordinate with infra.
Tom: manual scale submitted to autoscaler controller. new target replicas 26. controller accepted and cloud requested instances.
ops-bot: Cloud provider scheduled allocation, estimated ready in 27min.
Jin: monitoring: p95 at 1.8s now, p99 oscillating between 4s-6s. error rate down to 0.3%.
Sam (Support): sending templated update to affected customers: "We've applied temporary throttles and a fallback model to reduce timeouts; we're provisioning more capacity. We'll follow up with post-incident note."
Aisha: assigning follow-ups:
- Tom: document autoscaler behavior that triggered (scale_bound + cloud quota) and add clearer alert when scale request rejected due to quota (INC-2026-3345-F1).
- Jin: write guidance for use of fallback model variants and automated pre-warm rules (INC-2026-3345-F2).
- Lena: track cloud provider quota case, request permanent quota bump or reserved dedicated slots for bursty tenants (INC-2026-3345-F3).
- Sam: compile customer impact list and send out Affected Customer digest.
Tom: note: autoscaler logs snippet for postmortem: 
```
2026-06-14T03:12:45Z INFO scale_request: desired=28 current=20
2026-06-14T03:12:46Z ERROR scale_rejected: reason=quota scale_bound=20 cloud_err=QuotaExceeded
```
Aisha: we need one more thing — add a new alert that triggers when queue > 10k AND autoscaler rejections > 0 for 2m, so we can triage faster next time. Jin, can you add to alerts?
Jin: will do. Also adding playbook steps: if quota hit, auto-activate fallback routing and throttle top offending tenant.
Lena: ops note: we've scheduled a 1hr on-call timeout window with Dedicated ops to keep manual provisioning available for next 72h while quotas get fixed.
Aisha: severity de-escalation: affected customers still seeing some elevated latencies but service is functionally degraded, moving to mitigation state. Please note any lingering errors.
Tom: handing off to next oncall (Jin) for overnight monitoring. I'll stay available for 30m. last check: p95 1.6s, queue 3.8k, error 0.2%.
Jin: taking handoff. capturing timeline and notes in INC-2026-3345. I'll follow up on alerts and fallback automation.
Aisha: thanks team. Sam please make sure partner-alpha gets a direct update that we've applied throttles and are provisioning capacity; offer a follow-up call.
Sam (Support): sending now.
Aisha: handoff complete 2026-06-14T04:11Z. monitoring channel remains open. :white_check_mark:
